noticias.titular: Braves to put Martín Pérez on IL (back); likely out until NLCS
noticias.texto: The Braves plan to put Martín Pérez on the 15-day IL with lower back inflammation, leaving Atlanta short-handed in its starting rotation for the postseason.

noticias.titular: Cubs earn second straight playoff berth with win over Marlins
noticias.texto: The Chicago Cubs clinched their second straight postseason berth a 2-1 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday.

noticias.titular: White Sox clinch playoff berth after back-to-back 100-loss seasons
noticias.texto: The White Sox became the first team to follow consecutive 100-loss seasons by reaching the playoffs, clinching at least an AL Wild Card berth with win No. 82 this year.

noticias.titular: Phillies' Luzardo throws bullpen, confident for playoff return
noticias.texto: Phillies All-Star left-hander Jesús Luzardo said he has recovered enough from left shoulder inflammation that he should be able to pitch next week in the playoffs.

noticias.titular: Mets add former Twins executive Derek Falvey to front office
noticias.texto: The Mets named Derek Falvey senior adviser for baseball operations, a move that comes eight months after a mutual agreement with the Twins to leave that organization after nearly a decade.

noticias.titular: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong becomes 7th to reach 40/40 mark
noticias.texto: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong became the seventh player in MLB history to join the 40/40 club after stealing his 40th base of the season on Thursday.

noticias.titular: Ben Rice tops Aaron Boone's preseason prediction, passes 40 HRs
noticias.texto: Yankees manager Aaron Boone predicted during spring training that Ben Rice would finish with 39 home runs this season. Rice is two-up after hitting Nos. 40 and 41 in a 9-2 victory over the Rays, tying for the AL home run lead.
